items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23
items.q: And then the next band I got with was Joe Liggins, Honeydresser. I stayed with him five years. Six years. All six.

ctx.x: That's 1939. We left here. He used to be at the Cotton Club here. We went to New York, Boston and all that. Stayed back there about two years until the war comes and the war starts taking so many musicians and we come back to California. And I played around here about a year. And then the next band I got with was Joe Liggins, Honeydresser. I stayed with him five years. Six years. All six.
